faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: FreqDash is a professional web dashboard for monitoring and managing an unlimited number of Freqtrade trading bots from a single interface. Suitable for both beginners and experienced traders.
faq.q2: Do I need my own server?
faq.a2: Yes, FreqDash is installed on your own server (VPS) via Docker. Full control over your data and bots.
faq.q3: What's the difference between subscription and Lifetime?
faq.a3: Subscription — 4,990 ₽/month with updates and support. Lifetime — one-time payment of 49,900 ₽, yours forever with all future updates.
faq.q4: How many bots can I connect?
faq.a4: Unlimited. FreqDash is designed to scale — from one bot to an entire fleet.
faq.a5: Yes, you can test the dashboard in demo mode before purchasing. Contact us on Telegram for access.
faq.a6: Subscription users get updates automatically. Lifetime users receive all future updates for free.
